Name: Krobus Ghost Costume
Author: MarcyTheBeast
Description:
[size=4]Overview
[/size]
This mod gives Krobus a very spooky ghost costume, which totally isn't just a sheet that he put over his head.

This replaces all of his regular portraits and sprites, not including the trenchcoat or raven sprites.

[size=4]Requirements

[/size][size=3]This mod requires Content Patcher to function.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=1]Compatible with 1.6+ versions of the game.[/size][size=4]



Made for Stardew Valley Discord 2024 Spirit's Eve event.
[/size]
